name: Perfection Leather
body:
Source Inner Sea Gods pg. 253
Aura faint divination, necromancy, and transmutation CL 3rd
Slot armor; Price 3,860 gp; Weight 15 lbs.
Description
This +1 leather armor is usually inscribed with Irori’s open-hand symbol at the neck, and with meditative mantras along the sleeves. The wearer can use guidance, stone fistAPG, and touch of fatigue each once per day.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, guidance, stone fistAPG, touch of fatigue; Price 2,010 gp
